items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room, like-for-like
items.rationale: Lightning overvoltage (2.3.3) to a fixed climate unit about 7 m from the hob, so the 5 m exclusion in 2.3.10(c) does not apply. Like-for-like replacement is indemnified under 7.1.9(a) at a customary installed-trade rate.
The unit sits about 2 m from the hob, so 2.3.10(c) excludes overvoltage damage to it, and no kitchen climate endorsement is on the schedule. Not indemnified.

Under 7.1.9(c) the labour of removing, fitting, connecting and commissioning the covered replacement is indemnified. However, this line type was never paid in the earlier cases, so cover is uncertain.
This is an ancillary charge to the excluded kitchen unit. Under 7.1.11 it follows its principal item, so it is not covered.
The old stand was scorched and cannot be reused, and the replacement is an equivalent support needed to set the unit in place. It is indemnified under 7.1.9(b).
Ordinary carriage is covered for the living-room unit only. Under 7.1.11 the charge is apportioned by value, giving roughly 50-55% of a full freight charge of about 85 EUR.
